# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-28

This Xteink X4 Pro release fixes authenticated Calibre library synchronization.

## Fixed

- Fixed Calibre sync failing with HTTP 400 when the server requires Basic authentication.
- Ensured the firmware sends exactly one Authorization header for authenticated OPDS requests.
- Added support for accounts whose password is empty.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 Pro only.
- The OTA binary is published through the self-hosted CrossPoint release service.
